fields.title: Sepsis after surgery: an unfolding case study
objectives: Recognize the cues that show a patient is changing
Analyze the cues and prioritize the likely explanations
Choose the actions that bring help early
fields.scenarioSummary: A simulated patient, day 2 after surgery. The case unfolds in six stages. At each stage you see new information and answer questions about what you notice, what it means, what to do and whether it worked.
groundRules: What is said in the simulation stays in the simulation.
This is a safe place to be wrong. We are here to learn how we think.
The patient is simulated. Treat the case as real so the practice is useful.
You may step out at any time.
orientation: How the case unfolds: stages, new data, questions at each stage.
The tools you will see: monitor trends, flowsheets and handoff forms.
fields.contentNotice: This case includes the death of a patient.
fields.scoreNote: Scores use this app's own scale. They are not NCLEX scores.
fields.privacyNote: Your instructor can see your answers in a class session.
